name: std::chrono::locate_zone
intro: Convenience function for locating a time zone in the time zone database. Equivalent to std::chrono::get_tzdb().locate_zone(tz_name).

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: std::runtime_error if the specified time zone cannot be found, or if this is the first reference to the time zone database and the time zone database cannot be initialized.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: A call to this function that is the first reference to the time zone database will cause it to be initialized.

summary: Convenience function for locating a time zone in the time zone database. Equivalent to std::chrono::get_tzdb().locate_zone(tz_name).

recommendedExamples.title: Related example: std::chrono::day
recommendedExamples.input: Represent a valid calendar component or date in March 2024, then convert it to text.
